steps.title: Round 1 · our offer to sup:70240
steps.caption: Opening e-mail to sup:70240: €30.51 per unit with delivery record. Every figure comes from code; the model only added one polite sentence.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.
We have noted your offer and lead time, and we share your wish to build a reliable, long-term partnership. Our proposal confirms a binding volume, which we hope gives your team a solid basis for planning.

We confirm a binding volume of 4200 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 30.51 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, for our full demand of 4200 units a year over 24 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Hallo, the 14 days payment helps us a lot, cash is king in a shop like ours. With that and the 35 days lead time to sort out the delivery hiccups you mentioned, I can beat your other offer and do 30.50. So, we offer a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's agree on this and get the machines running. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

steps.title: How HackIt Buyer works
steps.caption: Code owns every number. A belief about each supplier, narrowed by every reply, and a planner that scores candidate prices in euros - not a fixed recipe. Guards that never bend: no sheet above the alternative, no token moves, never push after a final offer, no walk-away while an acceptable sheet stands.
